correctness.rationale: All 344 ordinary and 284 perfect matching faces are enumerated from exactly fifteen explicit edges; relative chains comprise thirty 2-faces and thirty 3-faces. Exact signed 30-by-30 incidence decomposes into ten 1-by-1 unit blocks and two 10-by-10 blocks of determinant -2 with unit 9-by-9 minors, proving relative H2=(Z/2)^2 and H3=0. Independently acyclic Hasse matchings (141 and 167 pairs) and a 4-by-6 Morse boundary with unit 4-by-4 minor give both wedge-of-two-S2 homotopy types. The long exact sequence forces Smith (2,2). Self-contained verifier run returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Problem 26 in the motivating 2026 paper requests ordinary Möbius-ladder matching topology. The ten-vertex instance exposes two independent order-two relative obstructions despite equal absolute wedge homotopy types, answering a natural question about the canonical subcomplex inclusion. The exact signed-cycle splitting explains the index rather than merely reporting homology ranks; it is an informative boundary example without requiring a general family theorem.
